doc.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

chapter: Playing, records and the Hyman album
title: Reference Recordings at SUNY Purchase and omni microphones
summary: The Hyman album was recorded live with a few omnidirectional mics in the theater, giving a different sound.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: I’ve been waiting to ask you about that record because I know when you record so many things sometimes you can’t really remember them. It’s like a day at work, right?
Yes sir, up in White Plains.

And I think they had some new microphones, some omni-directional microphones I think, that they set up on the stage instead of having mics on each and every instrument you know, and overhanging the drums and on the bass and the snare and stuff. They had one or two or three microphones set up to catch the live effects of the auditorium, the theater that we were playing in. So the sound is different.
